The shared candy CLOSURE this repo resolves against — one `candy:` list naming
every standalone candy repo whose entities the images here need, so a bare
reference like `kde-shell` resolves without each box pinning it individually.

It is NOT the marketplace generation source, despite the shared directory name.
That is `candy/charly-marketplace/charly.yml` in opencharly/marketplace, which
declares the `marketplace:` entity and is what `charly marketplace generate`
reads. This file declares no `marketplace:` entity and no generation happens in
this repo.

It is therefore NOT expected to match the marketplace repo's list, and must not
be "synced" to it: the two answer different questions — what this repo's images
need, versus what the published corpus is generated from. They have already
diverged in both directions.

Do not delete it as a redundant copy either. Removing it breaks resolution here:
`charly box validate` then fails with `unknown candy "kde-shell"` among others.
